GM plans $2 billion investment at Lansing plants
LANSING, Mich. (News 10) - he Lansing Regional Chamber of Commerce is celebrating a series of economic wins, including a $2 billion investment planned by General Motors.
GM said the money will be spent across its Lansing Grand River and Lansing Delta Township manufacturing plants.
In a statement, Tim Daman, president and CEO of the Lansing Regional Chamber of Commerce, said the investments are about much more than building vehicles. He said they are about supporting thousands of hard-working men and women.
